crossRefs.note: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral…
Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins…
Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;
Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.
But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to…

translations.web: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.
translations.bsb: We should not commit sexual immorality, as some of them did, and in one day twenty-three thousand of them died.
translations.kjv: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.
translations.asv: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.
